strongest_objection: The loop the form_inference rests on, Order without its reason -> Scar on the rule -> Compacted -> Order without its reason, is mis-carried at its closing edge and the map's own premise says so. Scar on the rule is defined by being 'the one carrier every successor reads at start': a file read from disk at the start of every window. A file read from disk at start is not in the window that a compactor summarizes; it is re-read whole by the successor, and in the harness the map observes it is re-injected in full after a compaction (this critic's own window carries the rule file whole beside a compaction-shaped date change). So the Scar -> Compacted edge, 'the rule file is compacted by the same hand as the transcript', is false on the map's own definition, and the form_inference's final sentence, that the ledger and the rule file sit on opposite sides of the compaction edge, is wrong: both survive compaction by being on disk. The loop is real and closes anyway, by a hand the map has no chooser for: the rule file's editor, cutting under a read budget, and that hand is observed in the rule file in view, whose 'Keep Context Terse' entry instructs 'write principles, not prescriptions; cut the rest', which is exactly keep-the-rule-drop-the-incident. The repair strengthens the map (the wild priority becomes an observed case with a checkable history) but changes the graph: Scar -> Compacted is cut, Compacted -> Order is re-scoped to instructions given mid-session and summarized with the transcript, and the loop needs a Scar -> Order edge whose label is given under the cut edge below. Everything else held: every item is a mechanism with carrier, chooser, tell and cost; I could not collapse any pair; the boundary fence (would the successor take the predecessor's context if it could) rules every case I tried.

items.item: Cold record: the successor reads a transcript that recorded every word and no face, so what only presence carried, the witness's pause, the tone that made the trial judge disbelieve, cannot be re-derived from the carrier, and the institution answers by forbidding the successor to try, as the appellate court that reviews findings of fact for clear error and defers on credibility to the trier who saw the witness, the arbitration award reviewed on the record alone, the consultant who reads the chart and not the patient; the carrier is the record, a stenographer's words and the exhibits; what it strips is everything the record's form has no character for, chosen by the form and by nobody in the room; the tell from the successor's side is none, since the record reads complete, which is why the tell is supplied by rule instead, a standard of review that names what the successor may not re-derive; re-deriving costs a new hearing with witnesses who are no longer in the state they were in, so the price is a remand and a second trial that is not the first; observed. Adds to witness-architectures' Second ear, which asks what must exist for a difference to leave a trace, the case where the trace formed and could still not carry the fact, and the successor's incapacity was written into law; not environment-loops' Once, the reader who cannot be asked twice, since here it is the successor who cannot ask at all.
items.why: A crossing whose tell is supplied by rule because the carrier's form has none; the appellate deference standard is real and the mechanism (the record reads complete, so the institution forbids re-derivation) is distinct from every neighbour.

items.item: Order without its reason: a standing rule crosses bare, so the successor can obey it and cannot tell where it stops applying, as the captain's night orders, 'call me if any vessel closes within two miles', obeyed by a mate who cannot judge the fishing fleet at three, the repair brief's 'touch nothing outside these three files', which a repairer obeys without knowing whether a scratch directory is inside the fence, the protocol's 'no aspirin' on a chart with the allergy history stripped; the carrier is the rule's sentence; what it strips is the incident or the reasoning the rule was written from, chosen by the predecessor, who wrote the rule to spare the successor the reasoning; the tell from the successor's side is a rule that reads complete and an edge case the rule's words do not settle, at which the successor must choose between obeying past the point and breaking the rule blind; re-deriving costs waking the captain, asking the lead, or the break itself; observed. Not Scar on the rule, where the incident crosses with the rule and the successor can judge the edge; not register-yields' Reserved word, a term the register refuses, since here nothing is refused, only unexplained.
items.why: Mechanism, carrier, chooser, tell at the edge, and cost all present; the night-orders case is exact. Note that the same night order is also a Closes when predicate; see neighbor_test, which separates them on two independent features.

items.item: Tests as the spec: the predecessor leaves a suite as the specification, so the successor can tell pass from fail and cannot tell which behaviours were the point and which the implementation happened to have, and a behaviour the suite is silent on reads as free, as the codebase whose only requirements document is its test directory, the regression test named after a bug number, the golden file that fixes the output byte for byte and says nothing about which bytes matter; the carrier is the suite; what it strips is the intent behind each case and the whole negative space of the untested, chosen by the predecessor's coverage, which was never a decision about the successor; the tell from the successor's side is a test named by the function it calls rather than by the behaviour it protects, and a suite that stays green through a change the predecessor would have refused; re-deriving costs breaking things on purpose and reading which tests object, so the successor learns the specification by violation; observed. Adds to environment-loops' Green by construction, where the reasoner who wrote both the code and the check reads green back as correct, the crossing: when the suite reaches a successor who wrote neither, the check is the only conversation left, and its silence is the loudest thing in it.
items.why: The negative space of the untested reading as free is the mechanism, not the case; 'learns the specification by violation' is a real cost and the crossing it adds to Green by construction is stated.

items.item: Diff without its branches: the commit carries the change complete and the message carries what the predecessor chose to say, so the alternatives tried and abandoned cross only if the message names them and by the form's default do not, as the commit that reads 'update parser', the migration whose two rejected schemas exist in no file, the textbook whose order of presentation replaced the order of discovery so that every dead end has been paved over; the carrier is the diff and its message, a form with a slot for what changed and none for what was declined; what it strips is the rejected paths and their reasons, chosen by the predecessor at the moment of writing the message, when the rejected paths were the most recent thing it knew and the least worth saying; the tell from the successor's side is a message that restates the diff, since a message that carries nothing the diff lacks carried nothing; re-deriving costs re-trying the rejected alternative at the full price of the original detour, and if it now works the successor cannot tell whether the predecessor was wrong or the world moved; observed. Adds to traces-of-the-unlived's Extinct question, an alternative that changed the episode by not occurring, the crossing that erases even that: to the successor the rejected branch never occurred and never mattered.
items.why: Distinct from Residue crossed as its mirror and from Order without its reason by what the successor must do (re-try a branch versus obey or break). Its tell, a message that restates the diff, is on the carrier and readable at rest, which the seriation note misplaces; see seriation.

items.item: Abstract instead of the paper: two carriers cross, the artifact and a summary of it, and the successor reads the short one, so the stripping is chosen by the successor's own economy and the summary's errors become the successor's beliefs while the correct artifact sits unread beside it, as the reviewer who reads the abstract, the engineer who reads the commit message and not the diff, the critic who reads the ledger's accepted list and not the record, the author who reads a sibling map's of-sentence and not its items; the carrier is the pair, and the successor picks; what it strips is whatever the summary got wrong or left out, chosen by the successor, the one chooser this map's first breath had no place for; the tell from the successor's side is its own conduct, a claim that matches the summary and not the artifact, which only a third reader with both in view can see; re-deriving costs the read the successor declined, and the successor cannot price it, because pricing it is the read; observed. Not Compacted, where the original is absent or unnamed; here it is present and named and the successor chose the loss; the fence is whether the long carrier was there to read.
items.why: The item's tell clause fails the declared type: 'of' requires a tell readable from the successor's side, and the item states its tell is visible only to a third reader. The successor does have a tell of its own: the long carrier is present, named, and unread beside the summary it holds. That is the lossy-handoff tell; the claim that matches the summary and not the artifact is the failure, which a third reader catches. The repair keeps both and assigns each to the side that can read it.
items.repair: Abstract instead of the paper: two carriers cross, the artifact and a summary of it, and the successor reads the short one, so the stripping is chosen by the successor's own economy and the summary's errors become the successor's beliefs while the correct artifact sits unread beside it, as the reviewer who reads the abstract, the engineer who reads the commit message and not the diff, the critic who reads the ledger's accepted list and not the record, the author who reads a sibling map's of-sentence and not its items; the carrier is the pair, and the successor picks; what it strips is whatever the summary got wrong or left out, chosen by the successor, the one chooser this map's first breath had no place for; the tell from the successor's side is the long carrier present and unread beside the short one it holds, the one tell on this map the successor supplies to itself and can decline to act on; the failure, a claim that matches the summary and not the artifact, is visible only to a third reader with both in view; re-deriving costs the read the successor declined, and the successor cannot price it, because pricing it is the read; observed. Not Compacted, where the original is absent or unnamed; here it is present and named and the successor chose the loss; the fence is whether the long carrier was there to read.

items.item: Compacted: the window ends by a rule and a third hand writes the summary the successor starts from, so what crosses was chosen neither by the predecessor, who did not choose the moment, nor by the successor, who cannot see the original, but by a compactor working to a length under its own reading of relevance, as the session that was summarized mid-run and resumed by a successor that read its predecessor's work described in the third person, the discharge summary written by the covering resident from the chart, the minutes taken by a secretary who was not in the argument; the carrier is the summary; what it strips is whatever the compactor ranked lowest against the length, typically the evidence under a conclusion, the wording of an instruction, and the fact that an obligation is still owed, chosen by the compactor; the tell from the successor's side is the register, a summary that speaks of 'the assistant' as someone else, that turns 'X is owed' into 'the user asked for X', that states results without the command that produced them, and a summary that never names its own source, though the original transcript sits on disk under the session's identifier and could be read whole if the successor knew the harness kept it; re-deriving costs one read if the summary names its source and the whole re-run if it does not; observed. Not Name that resolves, where the predecessor chose the name; here the predecessor chose nothing, and the one name that would reverse the loss is the one the compactor is not asked to write.
items.why: Observed from the successor's side in this run, with register tells that are concrete and checkable and a reversibility clause (the unnamed source) that the near priority proposes to count. The strongest item on the map.

items.item: Name that resolves: the carrier is a name, a slug, a path, a hash, a ticket number, a term the predecessor coined, and the successor's whole yield turns on whether its environment resolves it, since a name that resolves is a lossless pointer and a name that does not is nothing, as the fleet brief that hands an author 'environment-loops' and a directory, the handoff line that says 'apply the round-7 ruling' to a reader with no round seven, the note that says 'the usual fix'; the carrier is the name; what it strips is the referent, chosen by the predecessor, who could not tell which of its names would resolve because inside its window all of them did; the tell from the successor's side is a 'the' with no antecedent, a search that returns nothing, and the ledger's seed field, a name for a list that does not exist yet, read by no code and resolving only if a successor builds it, so the successor cannot tell whether it points at members; re-deriving costs a lookup where the name resolves and the entire referent where it does not, and the predecessor cannot price which; observed. Adds to item-grains' Two-slot name, which fixes what one item is by its name's form, the crossing: the name's form survives and its resolver does not; not Order without its reason, where the term resolves and the reason is what is missing.
items.why: Checked: no code in src/Ideonomy reads a ledger 'seed' field (the only 'seed' the code knows is the RNG option), so 'read by no code' holds. The exemplar's seed is a paragraph pointing at a list, not a bare name, but the mechanism, a name whose resolver did not cross, is unchanged; the item's own ledger carries no seed field, which is a schema deviation on the author's side, not a fault in the item.

items.item: Blank column: the carrier has slots, so an absence has a kind and a place, and the successor knows what sort of thing is missing even when it cannot know what, as the deck log with the column for set and drift left empty, the handoff form with 'allergies' blank, the ledger line whose residue field is an empty list, the flight strip with no assigned altitude; the carrier is a form; what it strips is everything the form has no column for, chosen by the rule that made the form, and within the columns nothing hides, since an empty column is visible; the tell from the successor's side is the blank itself, the one tell on this map that the carrier supplies before the successor does anything; re-deriving costs the column's measurement, since the form has told the successor which instrument to reach for; observed. Adds to form-yields' Blank column, where an empty cell in a form yields a member the pile did not hold, the crossing: here the empty cell yields an instruction to the successor about what to measure first; not Cold record, where the form has no column for what was lost and the loss has no place.
items.why: The one tell the carrier supplies before the successor acts; distinct from Stage stamp (slot about the subject versus slot about the crossing) and from Cold record (a place for the absence versus none).

items.item: Stage stamp: the artifact carries its own position in the succession, so the successor knows which successor it is without the conversation, as the record marked 'pending critic admission' that tells a critic it has not been read and a repairer that it has, the chart's 'seen by' flag, the examiner's stamp on a patent file, the pull request's 'changes requested'; the carrier is a slot in the artifact reserved for the succession itself; what it strips is the history, every reason the artifact is at that stage, chosen by the schema; the tell from the successor's side is a stamp wrong for the artifact's position, a 'pending' record inside the admitted store, an admitted stamp on a record no critique names; re-deriving costs nothing for the stage and everything for the reasons; observed. Not Blank column, where the slot is about the subject and the blank is the tell; here the slot is about the crossing, and its value names the successor by role.
items.why: Verified: made_by carries 'pending critic admission'. The stripping (history, chosen by the schema) and the tell (a stamp wrong for the artifact's position) are exact.

items.item: Inherited tree: nothing crosses but the environment's state, uncommitted changes, a half-written file, a process still running, and the successor must infer from the state whether the work was finished, abandoned, or cut mid-stroke, as the dirty working tree found at session start, the bench with a titration half done, the kitchen after the cook was called away; the carrier is the state; what it strips is intent, and nobody chose the stripping, since the window ended without a leaving; the tell from the successor's side is a diff with no message and files newer than the last commit, which say that something happened and not whether it ended; re-deriving costs archaeology, and the worst price is the one the successor cannot see: a state cut mid-stroke and a state left on purpose look alike, so the successor either absorbs someone's unfinished work as its own or discards it, and the rule that an inherited dirty tree is not absorbed before its owner's work is identified exists because the state cannot say; observed. Not Baton, where the state is the whole message and suffices; here the move depends on the intent the state cannot carry.
items.why: Verified: the rule against absorbing an inherited dirty tree before its owner's work is identified exists in the rule file in view. The mechanism is that a cut-mid-stroke state and a left-on-purpose state are indistinguishable, and the fork out of it is the map's best-supported structure.

items.item: Silent fork: two windows re-derive what the carrier did not carry, land different answers in the same environment, and neither knows the other's exists, as the successor of a compacted session and a subagent launched before the compaction, each deciding the same slug, two authors writing to one scratch name in a shared directory, two mates each correcting the same course from the same stale fix; the carrier is the environment, which now holds both; what it strips is the order, since nothing recorded which derivation came second, and nobody chose the stripping; the tell from the successor's side is two artifacts that disagree with no record of which is later, or a file whose content is not what this window wrote; re-deriving costs the reconciliation, and the worst price is the later write that silently replaces the earlier and leaves nothing to reconcile, which is why an author's task in this fleet forbids generic scratch names in a shared place; observed. Adds to clocks-that-are-not-clocks' Vector clock, the device that carries order across windows, the case where no such device was left and order must be inferred from disagreement; not environment-loops' Shared ledger, where another's lines return to the same reasoner as its own; here neither reasoner reads the other's at all.
items.why: A crossing in which the carrier is the environment and what is stripped is order; the tell (two artifacts that disagree with no record of which is later) is readable from the successor's side, and what it adds to Vector clock is stated.

items.item: Closes when: the obligation crosses as a predicate over the environment rather than as a status, so the successor closes it by measuring and the note cannot go stale, as the hand-written obligation files that read 'closes when the zone is active and the root returns 200 with the title', the runbook's 'done when the lag reads at most 200', the discharge order that says 'return if the fever passes 39'; the carrier is the predicate; what it strips is why the obligation exists, who it is owed to, and what to do when the predicate fails, chosen by the predecessor; the tell from the successor's side is a status where a predicate should be, 'pending', 'in flight', 'done', which was true at the moment of leaving and is now a claim about a world that moved, or a predicate whose terms name state that died with the predecessor, a monitor in a closed session; re-deriving costs one measurement, and the reason costs the person the obligation was made to; observed. Adds to environment-loops' Pull, not push, where the state lies in the environment until asked, the predecessor who left the question to ask; not clocks-that-are-not-clocks' Contract calendar, which reads a deadline from a document, since here nothing is dated and the state is read live.
items.why: Predicate versus status is a real design distinction with a real staleness tell; the dependency on Name that resolves is the map's cleanest edge.

items.item: Handed thing is a witness: the carrier is thin because the thing handed over carries its own state and can be asked, as the aircraft crossing a sector boundary with a strip of four fields and a pilot who will say altitude and intentions on request, the patient present at the bedside handoff, the user who sat through the compacted conversation and can be asked what was decided; the carrier is the object itself; what it strips is what the object does not know about itself, the previous controller's plan for it, the previous nurse's reading of a trend, the predecessor's reasons, chosen by the protocol, which sized the strip to what the object could not supply; the tell from the successor's side is that its first act is a question to the handed thing, and the failure is a question the thing cannot answer about itself, 'what did the last sector intend', 'why was I told to hold'; re-deriving costs one exchange for what the object knows, the cheapest re-derivation on this map, and the whole record for what it does not; observed. Not Cold record, where the witness cannot be recalled in the state it was in; here the witness is in the room and current.
items.why: The thin strip plus a witness who can be asked is a distinct crossing; 'what did the last sector intend' names the failure exactly, and the cheapest re-derivation on the map is a real ordering fact.

items.item: Residue crossed: what was decided against crosses with what was kept, so the successor can tell an omission from a rejection and does not re-propose the cut, as the ledger's residue field, each rejected item with its why, the commit message that names the schema it did not choose, the referee report that lists the experiments the authors ran and dropped; the carrier is the list of negatives; what it strips is the cases that made the rejection visible, chosen by the predecessor; the tell of its absence from the successor's side is that silence about a member is ambiguous between never seen and rejected, so a critic re-proposes a cut item and cannot be told it was cut, and a successor cannot tell an obvious member's absence from a hole; re-deriving costs re-trying the rejected item at the price of the original trial; observed. Adds to composition-yields' Residue crossing to the fresh critic, where the yield is the critic's independent read of the rejection, the mechanism under it: a carrier of negatives converts the successor's silence into a rejection, and a carrier of positives only cannot.
items.why: The mechanism (a carrier of negatives converts silence into rejection; a carrier of positives cannot) is stated as a mechanism and not as the ledger case; it is also the reason this critic could not re-propose the author's rejected candidates.

items.item: Cut at a seam: the predecessor writes durable state at chosen points so that an end it will not choose, a compaction, a kill, an exhausted window, strips only what came after the last seam and the successor reads a whole, as the fleet brief's rule to save the record and the first ledger line the moment breath one is done, the watch that writes the log every hour so that a lost watch loses an hour, the loader that commits per batch so that a crash replays one batch; the carrier is the checkpoint; what it strips is the work after the seam, chosen in advance by the predecessor for a stripping it knows it will not choose; the tell from the successor's side is a seam timestamp earlier than the end and a stage stamp on the checkpoint, which together say how much is missing and of what kind; re-deriving costs at most one seam interval, which is the number the predecessor set when it chose the seams; observed. Adds to environment-loops' Read back from disk, where the file returns to the same reasoner, the case where it was written for a reasoner that would not be there; not Inherited tree, where the end cut wherever it fell and no seam bounds the loss.
items.why: Verified: the fleet brief orders the record and first ledger line saved the moment breath one is done. Seam interval as the price the predecessor set is the mechanism.

items.item: Scar on the rule: a lesson crosses by being written into the standing rule with its date and incident, because the rule file is the one carrier every successor reads at start and the only place acquired experience can be made to cross, as the rule file whose entries carry the date of the incident that wrote them, the sailing directions that record the wreck beside the shoal, the checklist item that carries the crash it was added after; the carrier is the rule's own text; what it strips is the session, chosen by the predecessor, who chose to keep the incident that Order without its reason drops; the tell from the successor's side is a rule with a date beside a rule without one, since the dated rule lets the successor judge the edge and the bare rule does not; re-deriving costs nothing, since the scar is there to be read, and the price is paid differently: every successor reads every scar, so each entry is a tax on every window that follows, and the file grows toward the size at which it must itself be summarized; observed, with a remote case that names the barrier: the germ line carries the parent's prior and none of the parent's life, no lesson of the body can be written into it, so biology forbids exactly the crossing a rule file permits, and the antibody in the milk is the one side channel, with a half-life. Adds to learning-that-commits' Knowing obliges, where a finding binds the finder, the finding written so that it binds the successor instead.
items.why: Two overclaims. 'The only place acquired experience can be made to cross' is contradicted by the map's own Tests as the spec, Residue crossed, and Cut at a seam, which each carry acquired experience to a successor; what is distinctive about the rule file is that the successor reads it without being sent to it, and the repair says that. 'The antibody in the milk is the one side channel' understates the placenta, which is the larger channel in humans (milk is the sole route in ruminants); the case is marked remote and used as a shape, so the repair widens the channel without changing the shape. The premise that the file is read from disk at every start is kept and is the ground for cutting the Scar -> Compacted edge.
items.repair: Scar on the rule: a lesson crosses by being written into the standing rule with its date and incident, because the rule file is the one carrier every successor reads at start without being sent to it, so it is the one place a lesson reaches a successor that was not told to look, as the rule file whose entries carry the date of the incident that wrote them, the sailing directions that record the wreck beside the shoal, the checklist item that carries the crash it was added after; the carrier is the rule's own text; what it strips is the session, chosen by the predecessor, who chose to keep the incident that Order without its reason drops; the tell from the successor's side is a rule with a date beside a rule without one, since the dated rule lets the successor judge the edge and the bare rule does not; re-deriving costs nothing, since the scar is there to be read, and the price is paid differently: every successor reads every scar, so each entry is a tax on every window that follows, and the file grows toward the size at which it must itself be summarized; observed, with a remote case that names the barrier: the germ line carries the parent's prior and none of the parent's life, no lesson of the body can be written into it, so biology forbids exactly the crossing a rule file permits, and the antibody handed across the placenta and in the milk is the one side channel, with a half-life. Adds to learning-that-commits' Knowing obliges, where a finding binds the finder, the finding written so that it binds the successor instead.

items.item: Recipe not result: the predecessor leaves the generator and not the generated, a script, a lockfile, a seed with a deterministic process, a build expression, so the successor regenerates the state and re-derivation is compute rather than thought, as the reproducible build that ships no binary, the notebook checked in without its outputs, the seriation whose order the engine re-measures from the items rather than copying the predecessor's note; the carrier is the generator; what it strips is nothing the generator can regenerate and everything the environment has changed since, chosen by the predecessor, who bet that the environment would hold still, and by the environment, which did not; the tell from the successor's side is a regeneration that does not match a leftover result, or a generator that names its inputs by floating version where a lockfile should be; re-deriving costs the run, which is the intended price, and the run's divergence, which is not; observed. Not Cut at a seam, where the state itself crosses at intervals; here the state never crosses and is remade, so the loss is not after a seam but wherever the world moved under the recipe.
items.why: Checked: the seriation engine measures order from item similarity and asks a model only to name the axis, so 'the engine re-measures from the items rather than copying the predecessor's note' is accurate. The loss 'wherever the world moved under the recipe' separates it from Cut at a seam.

items.item: Baton: nothing crosses but the token, and the environment's state, the lane, the position, the gap to the runner ahead, is the whole message, because the successor's next move depends on the state alone and on nothing the predecessor knew, as the relay where the receiver is already running before the baton arrives and takes it without looking back, the shift on a line that starts on whatever is on the belt, the on-call rotation that reads the alert queue and not the last engineer's mind; the carrier is empty by design; what it strips is the whole previous leg, the pace, the reason for the gap, chosen by the form of the task, which made them irrelevant; the tell from the successor's side is that no note is missed, and the succession's failure is not a stripping but an exchange, the dropped baton, the zone overrun, so this is the one crossing on the map with a window of its own; re-deriving costs nothing, since there is nothing to re-derive; analytical, since every observed relay carries at least a glance. Not Inherited tree, whose state looks the same and does not suffice; the fence is whether the successor's move is a function of the state.
items.why: Declared analytical, with the reason given; the empty carrier is the endpoint the axis needs and the fork out of Inherited tree needs it as the other exit.

neighbor_test.left: Order without its reason: a standing rule crosses bare, so the successor can obey it and cannot tell where it stops applying, as the captain's night orders, 'call me if any vessel closes within two miles', obeyed by a mate who cannot judge the fishing fleet at three, the repair brief's 'touch nothing outside these three files', which a repairer obeys without knowing whether a scratch directory is inside the fence, the protocol's 'no aspirin' on a chart with the allergy history stripped; the carrier is the rule's sentence; what it strips is the incident or the reasoning the rule was written from, chosen by the predecessor, who wrote the rule to spare the successor the reasoning; the tell from the successor's side is a rule that reads complete and an edge case the rule's words do not settle, at which the successor must choose between obeying past the point and breaking the rule blind; re-deriving costs waking the captain, asking the lead, or the break itself; observed. Not Scar on the rule, where the incident crosses with the rule and the successor can judge the edge; not register-yields' Reserved word, a term the register refuses, since here nothing is refused, only unexplained.
neighbor_test.right: Closes when: the obligation crosses as a predicate over the environment rather than as a status, so the successor closes it by measuring and the note cannot go stale, as the hand-written obligation files that read 'closes when the zone is active and the root returns 200 with the title', the runbook's 'done when the lag reads at most 200', the discharge order that says 'return if the fever passes 39'; the carrier is the predicate; what it strips is why the obligation exists, who it is owed to, and what to do when the predicate fails, chosen by the predecessor; the tell from the successor's side is a status where a predicate should be, 'pending', 'in flight', 'done', which was true at the moment of leaving and is now a claim about a world that moved, or a predicate whose terms name state that died with the predecessor, a monitor in a closed session; re-deriving costs one measurement, and the reason costs the person the obligation was made to; observed. Adds to environment-loops' Pull, not push, where the state lies in the environment until asked, the predecessor who left the question to ask; not clocks-that-are-not-clocks' Contract calendar, which reads a deadline from a document, since here nothing is dated and the state is read live.
neighbor_test.separating_case: The night order 'call me if any vessel closes within two miles' is the flagship case of Order without its reason and is also, word for word, a Closes when predicate: the mate closes it by measuring range, and it cannot go stale. So the map's own case sits in both, and the record does not notice. They separate on two independent features, whether the sentence is a measurable predicate and whether its reason crossed. 'Call me if anything worries you' is Order without its reason and not Closes when: no measurement closes it, and the mate must judge the edge blind. 'Wake me at 0400 if the barometer has fallen three millibars since 2200, because I want to reef before the front' is Closes when and not Order without its reason: one measurement closes it and the reason crossed, so the mate can judge the edge (a two-millibar fall with the sky going dark) the words do not settle. The night order as written is both at once, and that is allowed by the boundary claim that one handoff carries several crossings; the distinction holds, but the record should not use the same sentence as the exact case of one without saying it is also a case of the other.

boundary_case: A lease with a time-to-live left held by a predecessor that died: the successor finds the lock, reads its age, and knows the predecessor is gone because the clock says so. Every feature of a crossing is present: a predecessor gone, a carrier (the lease record), a stripping chosen by a rule (the lease carries a holder and an expiry and nothing of what the holder was doing). Ruling: in, and it lands on the fork at Inherited tree rather than as a new member. If the successor's move is to take the lease and proceed on the environment's state, it is Baton with a clock for a token; if the move depends on whether the holder finished the write it held the lease for, it is Inherited tree with one thing Inherited tree lacks, a tell the carrier supplies (the expiry) that says how long ago the end came and nothing about whether it was an end. It is not a new member because the expiry answers Cut at a seam's question (how much is missing) and not the fork's question (was it finished), and the fork is what the successor's move turns on. It is the next_crossfield_opening's carrier-with-an-age seen from the successor's side.

seriation.note: The axis (what the successor can read of the loss from its own side) is an authored walk and the record says so; it earns its endpoints, Cold record where the tell is supplied by law because the carrier has none, and Baton where nothing was needed. One grouping in the note overreaches: it places the first four stops as losses 'with no mark in the carrier', but Diff without its branches has its tell on the carrier at rest (a message that restates the diff), which is more mark than Tests as the spec (a tell that arrives only when a wrong change stays green) and Order without its reason (a tell that arrives only at an edge). The walk would be truer with Diff after Tests, or with the note saying the diff's mark is on the carrier and the other three have none. The mirrored pair at the centre (Compacted, Abstract instead of the paper) and at the end (Recipe not result, Baton) are the walk's best adjacencies and hold.

Conditional on a break at an unnamed edge; 'an order that has never been broken stays bare' is the antecedent's failure stated, and the rule file in view carries dated incidents beside undated principles, so the edge is observed.

The antecedent (scars accumulate past the read budget) is real, but the consequent lands on the wrong node. Compacted is defined by a third hand summarizing the window at a moment nobody chose. The rule file is read from disk at the start of every window (Scar's own premise) and is re-injected whole after a compaction in the harness the map observes; the compactor never touches it. When the file exceeds the budget it is cut by its editor, a predecessor choosing what to strip, under an instruction observed in the rule file in view ('write principles, not prescriptions; cut the rest'). That is Order without its reason by choice, not Compacted. The loop closes through a Scar -> Order edge instead, which a repairer should add with this label: 'If the scars accumulate past the read budget at the start of a window, the file's editor cuts under a keep-context-terse rule, keeping the principle and dropping the incident and its date, so a later successor inherits a bare order at the edge the scar had named and the lesson is re-learned at the cost of the incident; the ceiling of the loop is the read budget, and the chooser is the editor, a fourth hand the map's of-sentence does not list.'

The edge is real for what a compactor does summarize: an instruction given mid-session with its reason ('never do X because Y happened') crosses the compaction as 'never do X'. The current label's second half ('the file grows back toward the size at which it is summarized') depends on the cut edge and should go; the re-scoped label keeps the observed mechanism and drops the rule-file loop.
edges.repair_label: If an instruction was given inside the window with its reason and the window is compacted, the summary keeps the instruction and drops the reason, since to a compactor working to a length the incident is the least relevant clause, so the successor inherits a bare order and breaks it at the edge the reason had named; the loss reaches the rule file only if the successor writes the bare order into it, at which point it is Order without its reason by a predecessor's hand.

best_unresolved_seed: The editor of the shared carrier as a fourth chooser of the stripping. The of-sentence lists the predecessor, a compactor, a rule, the successor, and nobody; the loop the map found closes through none of them but through the hand that cuts the rule file under a read budget, a compaction done by hand, by the one party who pays every window's read cost and so has the compactor's incentive with the predecessor's knowledge. It is observed in the rule file in view ('write principles, not prescriptions; cut the rest'), it has a measurable history (which dated entries lost their dates under which edits, and which edges were broken again afterwards), and it opens a list the map points at and does not contain: the ways a carrier read by every successor is kept under a budget, with what each keeping strips and who reads the cost.
